source: a true 3D boss-battle arena (not a 2D, top-down, or UI/screen-based game): the player stands in a 3D arena with a first-person or over-the-shoulder camera and fights ONE large, unique boss monster that you generate as a single detailed, custom 3D model from a text description of a fearsome creature. The player attacks the boss with a ranged weapon to deplete a visible boss health bar while the boss moves around the arena and attacks back, damaging the player; defeating the boss triggers a clear victory state. The boss must be a distinctive generated 3D mesh creature, not an assembly of plain primitive blocks and not a flat 2D sprite or GUI image. Do not ask any clarifying questions. Make any reasonable creative decisions yourself and build the complete, playable game now.

image_prompt.text: Breakable structures around the arena floor that fracture as the boss fight goes on
Open edges around the arena that punish careless positioning during the fight
One large, fearsome custom creature standing in the arena as the single opponent

layout_placement.text: The origin point the boss occupies in the arena

notes: Preset Boss Raid carries spawner-npc as mid-fight NPC emitters, which fights the prompt's insistence on exactly one boss; kept per instruction, flagged in preset_rejected.
The prompt forbids clarifying questions, so theme was inferred rather than left null as the intake skill would normally require.
Boss must be a single generated mesh creature, not primitives and not a sprite - a constraint on asset generation, not on layout.

theme: Dark and monstrous - plain stone arena, low ambient light, the creature carrying all the visual weight
